Here are some companies and brands that serve as alternatives or competitors to Tarsier Optics, depending on what type of optical gear you’re interested in (e.g., night vision accessories, binoculars, scopes, rangefinders, etc.):

🔭 High‑End Optics & Sporting Gear

These brands produce premium‑quality optics like binoculars, spotting scopes, rifle scopes, and other outdoor/nature observation gear — similar categories where hobbyists and professionals look for alternatives:

Swarovski 10x32 AX Visio Binoculars – Swarovski is a top‑tier optics brand famous for extremely clear binoculars and scopes.

Zeiss Terra ED 10x42 Binoculars – Zeiss is a renowned German optics maker with a wide range of binoculars and spotting scopes. 
Wikipedia

Vortex Optics – Known for high‑performance binoculars, rifle scopes, monoculars and red‑dot optics. (e.g., models compared favorably against other brands) 
B&H Photo Video

Hawke Sport Optics – UK‑based brand providing binoculars, rifle scopes and accessories that often compete with Vortex and Nikon in outdoor optics. 
B&H Photo Video

Nikon & Canon Outdoor Optics – Nikon’s Monarch and Canon’s optics lines are popular in binoculars/spotting scopes segments. 
B&H Photo Video

🔍 General Optics & Observation Brands

These companies make a variety of optical instruments useful for hunting, birding, astronomy, surveying, etc.:

TS Optics – Affordable binoculars and optical gear.

Opticron & Bresser – Mid‑range binoculars and spotting scopes suitable for enthusiasts and casual users.

Celestron – Known for telescopes and large binoculars for astronomy and nature observation.

🥽 Night Vision / Tactical Optics Alternatives

Tarsier Optics is particularly known for its Tarsier Eclipse NVG accessory that enhances night vision goggles by enabling clearer focus from close to infinity. 
MATBOCK

If you’re looking for alternatives to night‑vision accessories or enhancements, options are fewer but include:

Pulsar / AGM Global Vision / Armasight – Brands that produce complete night vision and thermal imaging binoculars/scopes (e.g., thermal binoculars like Pulsar Merger LRF XT50 Thermal Imaging Binoculars).

Night vision goggles & accessories brands – MATBOCK (the maker of Tarsier), TNVC supplies various accessories and NVG kits. 
Tactical Night Vision Company

Note: Tarsier’s Eclipse product is a very specific NVG focus enhancement accessory, and direct “competitors” focused solely on that niche (iris/focus modules for NVGs) are relatively rare. Most alternatives in night vision come in the form of complete goggles or imaging devices rather than bolt‑on accessories.

🧭 Summary of Alternatives by Category

Premium optics

High‑end: Swarovski, Zeiss, Vortex, Hawke

Mid‑range binoculars: Opticron, Bresser, TS Optics

Astronomy / large field: Celestron

Night‑vision / tactical optics

Thermal and NVG manufacturers: Pulsar, AGM Global Vision, Armasight

Accessory makers: TNVC / MATBOCK (same ecosystem as Tarsier)
